# Ezekiel 42 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-he-brought-me-out to the-outer court, the-way-of the-north, and-brought-me to the-chamber which [was] opposite the-separate-area and opposite the-building to-the-north.

**2** And-the-man measured the-sacred-space concerning the priests' chambers, according-to-the-pattern-of the-new-temple.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **42:1**: Opening formula for the oracle concerning the priests' chambers — prophetic context established.

- **42:10**: Central imagery of holy and common separated — integral to Ezekiel's prophetic architecture.

- **42:20**: Concluding formula — the divine word stands as spoken concerning chambers for priestly service.

— EMET
